glossary.definition: (A) "Person" includes individuals, firms, partnerships, associations, joint stock companies, corporations, and combinations of individuals of whatever form.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5743.31 to 5743.35 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 5743.31 - Cigarette use and storage tax definitions.

glossary.definition: (B) "Storage" includes any keeping or retention of cigarettes for use or consumption in this state.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5743.31 to 5743.35 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 5743.31 - Cigarette use and storage tax definitions.

glossary.definition: (C) "Use" includes the exercise of any right or power incidental to the ownership of cigarettes.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5743.31 to 5743.35 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 5743.31 - Cigarette use and storage tax definitions.

glossary.definition: (D) "Consumer" means any person who has title to, or possession of, cigarettes in storage, for use or other consumption in this state.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5743.31 to 5743.35 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 5743.31 - Cigarette use and storage tax definitions.
